description: Defines configuration options and a validator for Azure Table-based reminder storage in the Orleans framework, including the AzureTableReminderStorageOptions class with a TableName property and the AzureTableReminderStorageOptionsValidator class for validation.

classes.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for specifying the Azure Table name for reminders, inheriting from AzureStorageOperationOptions.

classes.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AzureTableReminderStorageOptions, inheriting from AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator.

methods.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor for validator, accepting options and name parameters.
